units.title: Actual PBPS phase Gibbs normalization

sources.label: Eq3.1 and conditional energy: positive finite phase partition and exact conditional-Gibbs times standard-Gaussian identification; source-implicit normalization used by Appendix A.1 averaging.
sources.scope: Exact phase probability normalization and product-law identity only; no process invariance, countable sector assembly, Markov property, hypocoercivity, implementation error, cost or main theorem completion.

assumptions: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E with canonical volume, including dimension zero.
alpha,beta>=0; alpha>0; alpha<=beta; V is C2; alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v.
eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. All conclusions hold for every y in E.

Literal conditional and phase energies, real Zx, ENNReal Zphase, C_E=(sqrt(2 pi))^d, tilted position law and standard Gaussian momentum. No extra integrability, normalizer, minimizing point or regularity premise.
units.statement:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel sigma algebra and canonical Lebesgue measure, including dimension d=0. Let V:E->R be C2. Let alpha,beta>=0 with alpha>0 and alpha<=beta, and assume alpha||v||^2 <= D2 V(x)[v,v] <= beta||v||^2 for every x,v in E, where D2 is the genuine second Frechet derivative. Let eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
For each y in E define Vy(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), U_y(x,p)=Vy(x)+||p||^2/2, w_y=exp(-U_y), and ell=volume_E times volume_E in position-momentum order. Define the real position partition Zx(y)=integral exp(-Vy(x)) dx, C_E=(sqrt(2 pi))^d using the natural-number power, and the extended nonnegative phase partition Zphase(y)=integral ofReal(w_y(z)) d ell(z). Let pi_y=volume_E.tilted(-Vy), meaning volume_E.withDensity(x -> ofReal(exp(-Vy(x))/Zx(y))). Let nu_y=ell.withDensity(z -> Zphase(y)^(-1)*ofReal(w_y(z))) and let gamma be the centered Gaussian on E with identity covariance.
Then for every y, all seven assertions hold: exp(-Vy) is integrable; Zx(y)>0; Zphase(y)=ofReal(Zx(y)*C_E); Zphase(y)>0; Zphase(y)<infinity; nu_y is a probability measure; and nu_y=pi_y times gamma exactly as measures on E times E. The real and extended-real integrals are therefore finite before normalization is justified. This identifies the actual phase law rather than a supplied density or normalizer. In dimension zero C_E=1 and the normalized measure is the unit atom on the singleton phase space. No minimizer, critical point, Gaussian envelope, measurability, integrability or finite-mass premise is added. Upper curvature, alpha<=beta and beta*eta<=1 remain as original source assumptions even though this analytic normalization proof needs only the lower curvature, C2 and eta>0. This result does not assert a process law, stationary averaging, countable sector assembly, invariance, a Markov property, hypocoercivity, simulation error, expected oracle cost or whole-paper/composition completion.
units.boundary: Exact phase probability normalization and product-law identity only; no process invariance, countable sector assembly, Markov property, hypocoercivity, implementation error, cost or main theorem completion.

steps.title: Obtain the integrable Gibbs tail
steps.text: The genuine Hessian lower bound and C2 regularity imply alpha-strong convexity. The existing positive-modulus Gibbs integrability theorem uses a quadratic envelope and requires no supplied minimizing or critical point.
steps.lean:
have hsc := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.HessianStrongConvexity.strongConvexOn_univ_of_fderiv2_lower hV (fun x v => (hH x v).1)
  have hbase := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.StrongConvexGibbsIntegrability.integrable_exp_neg_of_strongConvexOn hα (hV.differentiable (by norm_num)) hsc
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Control every conditional position partition
steps.text: For each y, eta>0 makes the proximal quadratic nonnegative, hence 0<exp(-Vy)<=exp(-V). Continuity yields measurability; domination proves integrability. Strict positivity of the exponential and nonzero canonical volume then give Zx>0, including dimension zero.
steps.lean:
have hVy : Continuous Vy := hV.continuous.add (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm.pow 2).div_const (2 * η))
  have hfc : Continuous f := Real.continuous_exp.comp hVy.neg
  have hgc : Continuous g := Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_norm.pow 2).neg.div_const 2)
  have hf : Integrable f (volume : Measure E) := by
    refine hbase.mono' hfc.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    dsimp [Vy]
    have : 0 ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hZ : 0 < Z := integral_exp_pos hf
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Evaluate the Gaussian momentum factor
steps.text: Apply the canonical Gaussian integral with coefficient 1/2. Convert its real power to the natural-number power of sqrt(2 pi). The resulting positive factor is C_E; no variance eta appears in momentum.
steps.lean:
have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hCg : (∫⁻ p : E, ENNReal.ofReal (g p) ∂volume) = ENNReal.ofReal C := by
    have h := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.Integrability.lintegral_exp_neg_mul_norm_sq_eq (E := E) (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    have hn : (Real.pi / (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) / 2) = C := by
      dsimp [C]
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast (by positivity)]
      congr 1 <;> ring
    rw [hn] at h
    convert h using 1
    congr 1
    funext p
    congr 2
    dsimp [g]
    ring
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Factor the actual phase partition
steps.text: The target energy is additive in position and momentum. Exponentiation factors its weight, and nonnegative product integration separates the two factors in position-first order. Integrability of the position factor permits the real-to-ENNReal integral conversion.
steps.lean:
have hw (z : E × E) : Real.exp (-U z) = f z.1 * g z.2 := by
    dsimp [U, f, g, Vy]
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hphase : Zp = ENNReal.ofReal (Z * C) := by
    calc
      Zp = ∫⁻ z : E × E, ENNReal.ofReal (f z.1) * ENNReal.ofReal (g z.2) ∂ell := by
        apply lintegral_congr
        intro z
        rw [hw, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _)]
      _ = (∫⁻ x : E, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂volume) * ∫⁻ p : E, ENNReal.ofReal (g p) ∂volume :=
        lintegral_prod_mul hfc.measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable hgc.measurable.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Z * C) := by
        rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf (ae_of_all _ (fun x => Real.exp_nonneg _)), hCg, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hZ.le]
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Normalize only after positivity and finiteness
steps.text: Both real factors are positive, and ofReal of a real number is finite. The existing Gibbs withDensity theorem now proves that the reciprocal-partition density has total mass one. No finite-mass premise was supplied.
steps.lean:
have hpos : 0 < Zp := by rw [hphase]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (mul_pos hZ hC)
  have hfin : Zp < ⊤ := by rw [hphase]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (ell.withDensity (fun z => Zp⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-U z)))) :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.Gibbs.isProbabilityMeasure_withDensity_normalized_gibbs ell U hpos.ne' hfin.ne
  refine ⟨hf, hZ, hphase, hpos, hfin, hprob, ?_⟩
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Identify standard Gaussian momentum
steps.text: Specialize the existing isotropic Gaussian density theorem to variance one. Scaling by sqrt(1) is the identity map, so the Gaussian density is C_E inverse times exp(-||p||^2/2). This also covers d=0.
steps.lean:
have hgamma : stdGaussian E = (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (C⁻¹ * g p)) := by
    have h := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.IsotropicGaussianDensity.map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity (E := E) 1 (by norm_num)
    have hid : (fun z : E => Real.sqrt 1 • z) = id := by funext z; simp
    rw [hid, Measure.map_id] at h
    simpa only [mul_one, inv_pow, C, g] using h
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.

steps.title: Match the normalized product density
steps.text: Expand the tilted position measure and use product-withDensity for the two measurable densities. Substitute the exact phase partition and factorized energy. Positivity and finite ofReal factors justify division and inversion; commutativity then identifies the densities pointwise and hence the measures.
steps.lean:
rw [hgamma, Measure.tilted, prod_withDensity ((hfc.measurable.div_const Z).ennreal_ofReal) ((hgc.measurable.const_mul C⁻¹).ennreal_ofReal)]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with z
  rw [hphase, hw, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hZ.le, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hZ, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hC.le), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hC]
  rw [ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inr ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top) (Or.inl ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, f]
  ac_rfl
steps.detail: ASTIS completion of the phase-law proportionality. Exact compiled region; every analytic ingredient is derived from the original assumptions.
